title: Correct documentation/control inconsistencies
status_detail: three deterministic corrections independently reviewed on 2026-08-09
objective: Consume harness.simplification.docs-json.authority-catalog and correct stale, duplicated, badly named, or misleading documentation when accepted authority determines one compatible correction. Preserve human intake and documentation-owned subject matter.
authorized_scope: Apply deterministic corrections directly, including stale status, activation, prerequisite, successor, completion, or acceptance prose whose operational owner is a chain or Task record; obsolete names and links; manual restatements that will be replaced by generated control-reference pages; historical material that is not clearly labeled historical; and naming that violates an accepted convention.
Resolve only the remaining ambiguity queue, asking the human only when applicable claims conflict, precedence does not resolve them, and materially different defensible corrections remain.
Validate links, names, historical/current labeling, and the absence of documentation-only activation paths.
Hand the remaining operational record families to harness.simplification.docs-json.schema-projection.

Documentation may locate or explain work, but it cannot activate a Task or supply executable scope; do not invent a new execution-target resolver unless an actual executable path violates this rule and a separate Task authorizes that behavior.
completion_criteria: Corrected documentation and resolved links preserve subject-matter contracts and human intake, record an explicit unresolved list if any, and provide a bounded schema-projection handoff.
exclusions: Do not create a human checkpoint for a deterministic correction governed by accepted authority.
Do not change scientific meaning, activate work, resolve checkpoints, create runtime routing, or perform repository-wide rewriting beyond authorized paths.
